subjects.label: Comparison with the first game
subjects.description: Measuring this sequel against its direct predecessor, being a fan of the first, preferring the old one modded or finding the new one better; comparisons with other city builders or genres stay under genre.

subjects.label: Roads and traffic
subjects.description: The road tools and how vehicles behave on them, lane changing, traffic signals and phasing, and jams; the wider economy and service systems belong in their own rows.

subjects.label: City economy and taxes
subjects.description: Taxes, the budget, upkeep and expenses, money running short and whether the economic simulation makes sense; road and traffic matters and the price of the game itself do not belong here.

subjects.label: City services and zone demand
subjects.description: The simulation of services such as rubbish collection and service buildings and their upgrades, zoning demand and export or trade working or failing; money and taxes stay under the economy row.

subjects.label: Hardware demands and overheating
subjects.description: The game needing a top-end card or absurd memory to run at all, cooking the GPU, heating the room or shutting the PC down; ordinary frame-rate and stutter complaints stay under performance.

subjects.label: Performance against city size
subjects.description: How large a city gets, measured in population, before the game slows or crashes, and whether that ceiling has moved; frame-rate complaints without a city size belong under performance.

subjects.label: Shipped unfinished, buy later
subjects.description: The game having launched in an early access state and the advice to wait for patches, years or a finished version before buying; whether a discount is worth waiting for is a price matter.

subjects.label: Realism and lessons in governing
subjects.description: The simulation as a mirror of real cities and governments, what playing mayor teaches about real politics and whether the outcome is realistic or absurd; plain political jokes with no link to the game are off topic.
